{{Quote|These steam tubes seem endless, Master Luke.''"<br />"''On a big industrial planet like Fondor, they probably are Threepio.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Darth Vader Strikes" />}}
'''Fondor's underground steam tubes''' were a huge pipeline network under the surface of the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="Darth Vader Strikes" />

==History==
[[File:CSW4-FC.png|thumb|left|200px|The first [[Mission to Fondor (Galactic Civil War)|meeting]] between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] took place in Fondor's underground steam tubes.]]

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Fondor's underground steam tubes were the site of a [[Mission to Fondor (Galactic Civil War)|meeting]] between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and six traitorous [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]]. One of them, Admiral [[Amise Griff]], was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The traitorous admirals were arrested, but the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to escape.<ref name="Darth Vader Strikes" />
